title: simulate_population — simulate_population
text: data_structure matrix data.frame named column grouping factor, including levels n Sample size data_structure specified parameters list parameters hierarchical level. See details. n_response number response variables, defaults 1. response_names Names given response variables. Defaults 'y', c('y1','y2',...) n_response>1. used model specified. known_predictors argument provides way inputting existing predictor variables. argument takes list, items 'predictors' 'beta', 'predictors' matrix data.frame, number rows MUST equal 'n' number rows 'data_structure'. column names 'predictors' used variable names, 'beta's assumed order predictors. model Optional. equation description simulation model given character string. See details. index_link Optional. Make new factors data structure indexed factors. really used context model argument. Takes list, names indicate new grouping factor name elements list represent grouping factors linked, example "mother-ID" index mother indexes ID. family description error distribution. Options 'gaussian' (default), 'poisson' 'binomial'. 'binomial' generates binary response variable. link description link function distribution. Options 'identity' (default),'log', 'inverse', 'sqrt', 'logit', 'probit' 'cloglog'. pedigree list pedigrees hierarchical level. pedigree must matrix data.frame, least 3 columns, correspond ID, dam sire. name pedigree list must match name parameter list. phylogeny list phylogenies hierarchical level. phylogeny phylo class. name phylogeny list must match name parameter list. cov_str list covariance structures hierarchical level. name cov_str list must match name parameter list. sample_type Type sampling, must one 'nested', 'missing', 'survival' 'temporal.' specified, sampling done. See details sample_param set parameters, specific sampling type. See details. n_pop Number populations. Default = 1 seed Seed random number generation. Setting seed allows simulations easily reproduced. seed set, one set internally, saved returned squidSim object verbose Logical. Whether print diagnostics. Useful debugging. Defaults FALSE suppress_index_warning Logical. Whether print warnings relating index-link argument. Useful switch using large number simulations. Defaults FALSE.

title: simulate_population — simulate_population
text: detailed vignette can found https://squidgroup.org/squidSim_vignette/ parameters list contains one () list hierarchical level want simulate . residual list always needed, specifying variances/covariances residual. Additionally, parameter list can also provided intercept vector interactions list. item parameter list (excluding intercept, interactions, residual), following can specified (default values): names - vector containing names predictors simulated level  group - character string relating data_structure mean - vector means predictor variables vcov vcorr - Either vector variances, variance-covariance/correlation matrix, predictor variables beta - vector effect sizes (matrix n_response columns n_response>1) fixed - Logical, indicating whether effects levels fixed simulated covariate - Logical, indicating whether indexes data structure used continuous variable rather simulating one functions - vector - transformation applied response variable. Defaults ‘identity’. detailed explanation can found https://squidgroup.org/squidSim_vignette/1.9-parameter-list-summary.html model argument character string explicitly tells simulate_population function put simulated predictors together form response variable. example, predictors temperature rainfall specified parameter list, providing model argument "y = temperature + rainfall + residual" result generating response variable 'y' way simulate_population function default. detailed information see http://squidgroup.org/squidSim_vignette/1.7-modeleq.html Different sampling schemes can implemented, (sample_type can 'nested', 'missing', 'survival' 'temporal'). sample_param takes different form depending sample_type. See https://squidgroup.org/squidSim_vignette/7-sampling.html full details.

title: squidSim 0.2.0
text: Simulation additive genetic effects now uses MCMCglmm::rbv internally. substantially faster! Removed nadiv dependency back CRAN, temporarily doesn’t simulate dominance epigenetic effects internally. can still done including matrices generated nadiv covariance structures

title: squidSim 0.2.1
text: Bug fixes simulating additive genetic effects, added index_link argument help indexing model argument. allows new factors data structure made indexed factors. Previously simulating maternal genetic effects didn’t work properly, indexing, solves problem.

title: squidSim 0.2.2
text: New survival sampling functionality. simulate binomial data age structure, can sample ages (including) first 0 1 (depending whether simulating survival mortality)

title: squidSim 0.2.3
text: Bug ‘fixed’ factor fixed. Now levels data structure names, names specified parameter list. order doesn’t matter (matched internally), names match exactly. factor levels data structure numeric need match; order effects match order numeric factor levels.

title: squidSim 0.2.4
text: Added ‘int_names’ argument make_structure function, allows combination/interaction terms named.

title: squidSim 0.2.5
text: Added cloglog link function simulate_population Added functions exp2lat lat2exp, convert means (co)variances normal log normal distributions, can used transform latent expected scales GLMs Fixed phylogenetic effect simulation

title: squidSim 0.2.6
text: Optimising sparse matrices speed simulating cov_str Updating internal error checking

title: squidSim 1.0.0
text: Major update preparing submission CRAN. Mainly fixing bugs documentation. follows comprehensive bug documentation check using Claude Opus 5.5 medium. bugs found changes suggested Claude checked thoroughly maintainers, automated bug correction used. Without seed, repeated calls simulate_population longer cycle small set datasets. simulate_population now leaves user’s random number stream found link="sqrt" now applies inverse link (squares linear predictor) Predictors 0 variance now equal mean, rather 0 mean now used pedigree phylogeny, mean longer transformed cov_str covariate=TRUE now uses values data structure, rather ranks Fixed factors can NAs data structure cov_str can levels data structure, checked symmetric positive definite Singular vcov matrices can now simulated Singular vcov matrices pedigrees 3 columns now work pedigree get_parameters works interactions includes known predictors Names intercept column names betas now ignored tibbles data.tables can used data structure Interactions now work predictors numeric names Sampling fixes: Nested sampling works one grouping factor, group single level factors, without data structure. Now gives error levels requested group , warning groups short. Temporal sampling works non-consecutive named time points, variance 0, longer excludes first time point. Missing sampling work groups end equal sized samples. simulated_variance now includes covariances involving two way interactions total variance informative errors make_structure get_sample_data Added tests. Now requires R (>= 4.1.0) simulated_variance removed version. now development branch, reinstated later version pedigree, phylogeny cov_str share grouping factor unlinked effect (e.g. additive genetic permanent environment effects)
